Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Security
Sponsor: Reynolds
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 03/24/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 507 as introduced could increase the obligations of the office of the Lieutenant Governor and the Legislature by an undetermined amount dependent upon if travel and per diem expenses are reimbursed for each meeting of the Alabama Council on Law Enforcement Policy established within the office of the Lieutenant Governor by this bill.
Allen Treadaway, Chair
Public Safety and Homeland Security
